headline: United's hubs run normally; a ground stop holds flights into LaGuardia.

items.text: United's hubs are running normally: all seven reporting so far today are at 84% on time or better, and no FAA program is in effect at any of them.

The FAA has a ground stop in effect for flights into New York LaGuardia (LGA) until 9:15 PM ET because of an equipment outage, and those flights are held at their departure airport. It rates the chance of an extension as low.

The FAA's operations plan lists four possible programs, none in effect now: Boston (tomorrow 1:00 PM ET), Miami and Fort Lauderdale (tomorrow 1:00 PM ET), San Diego (tomorrow 9:00 AM PT) and Seattle (tomorrow 6:00 AM PT).

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to LaGuardia, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
